versions.changelog:
Initial release of the ResearchClaw skill, wrapping the AutoResearchClaw 23-stage autonomous research pipeline.

- Automates setup, configuration, execution, monitoring, and troubleshooting of AutoResearchClaw.
- Provides user-invocable commands for setup, config generation, running the pipeline, checking status, resuming, diagnosing issues, and validation.
- Includes interactive wizards for configuration and dependency checks, with honest user prompts before making changes.
- Protects user environment with pre/post hooks for configuration and artifact deletion safeguards.
- Offers detailed error reporting and actionable suggestions for resolving failures, never fabricating capabilities.
